concept: Escanor, represented through his historical Sunshine era as its power rises from dawn toward noon. Sunshine was returned to Mael before Escanor later received it back for the Demon King battle, and its use damaged Escanor's human body; this plan does not imply present-day access or implement bodily harm (source1:6, source2:15, source2:16, source2:17, source2:32).

signature.name: Sunshine
signature.adaptation: Escanor's strength, size, heat and power rise during the day, reaching The One at noon for one minute. The Unit adapts the rising strength and heat through its purchases, not a real-time day cycle, a guaranteed invincibility, or the bodily cost.

repertoire.name: Sunshine
repertoire.limitation: Escanor's power rises from dawn to noon, The One lasts one minute, and Sunshine damages his human body. The plan does not simulate the time-of-day cycle, grant invulnerability, or implement bodily harm.

effects.effect: Sunshine raises Escanor's physical strength as it rises toward its noon peak.
effects.reason: Permanent damage improvements adapt the increasing force of Escanor's attacks as a Tower Defense effect.

effects.effect: Sunshine causes Escanor to radiate heat and light, and he can direct that power into attacks.
effects.reason: This plan does not adapt the radiated heat and light effect; no Sunshine purchase promises burn or splash.

effects.effect: At noon Escanor becomes The One for one minute, with greatly increased power.
effects.reason: The middle path's manual boost temporarily amplifies the existing attack; its game damage effect, duration and cooldown are proposals, not the source's one-minute duration. The boost does not adapt an increase in attack rate.

repertoire.name: Cruel Sun
repertoire.limitation: Escanor makes and directs a miniature sun, which can grow and melt nearby armor. The plan does not reproduce its physical object or armor-specific interaction.

effects.effect: Escanor creates a miniature sun whose heat melts nearby armor.
effects.reason: The top path adds area damage as a Tower Defense adaptation of heat affecting nearby enemies; armor-specific melting is not separately represented.

effects.effect: Escanor controls the sun with hand gestures and strikes opponents with it, increasing its size.
effects.reason: The top path's enlarged hit and area effect adapt the growing attack; the game does not represent a controllable sun object.

repertoire.name: Pride Flare
repertoire.limitation: Escanor flares Cruel Sun with heat powerful enough to vaporize a sizable lake in an instant. The plan adapts area damage, not the environmental feat or instantaneous vaporization.

effects.effect: Escanor flares Cruel Sun with extreme heat.
effects.reason: The top path's increased splash adapts the described heat affecting a broad area as a Tower Defense effect.

repertoire.name: Crazy Prominence
repertoire.limitation: Escanor produces many miniature suns that explode on impact. The Definition cannot express a number of independent suns beyond its projectile and splash promises; the plan uses a distinct multi-projectile volley, not independent homing suns.

effects.effect: Escanor produces multiple miniature suns that explode on impact.
effects.reason: The top capstone fires a distinct volley whose hits have splash, adapting multiple impact explosions without asserting independently targeted suns.

repertoire.name: Final Prominence
repertoire.limitation: As The One: Ultimate, Escanor concentrates all his power into a gigantic swirling fireball and hurls it. The plan does not claim that a normal attack is a separate fireball or that it spends Escanor's life force.

effects.effect: Escanor concentrates his power into a gigantic swirling fireball and hurls it at an opponent.
effects.reason: The middle capstone amplifies the purchased attack during its boost and adds a bounded follow-up as a Tower Defense approximation; it does not create a separate fireball.

repertoire.name: Rhitta
repertoire.limitation: Rhitta is Escanor's heavy, unbalanced Sacred Treasure axe. It absorbs his daytime heat and can release stored power on command; the plan does not implement storage, calling the axe, or an instant release separate from its ordinary attack.

effects.effect: Escanor wields the heavy axe Rhitta and strikes with it.
effects.reason: The base attack and its damage improvements adapt the axe's physical strikes.

effects.effect: Escanor imbues Rhitta so its axe slashes burn foes.
effects.reason: The bottom path adds burn to the ordinary attack as a Tower Defense adaptation of the burning slash.

effects.effect: Rhitta can absorb Escanor's daytime heat and release it precisely on command.
effects.reason: Heat storage and a separate command-triggered release are not expressed by the Definition; neither is presented as an ordinary attack improvement.

repertoire.name: Daytime
repertoire.limitation: Escanor grows physically and radiates heat during the day, with some control over the output. The plan does not simulate bodily transformation, allied protection, or a day clock.

effects.effect: Escanor's size, strength and radiated heat increase during daytime.
effects.reason: Damage increases and the supported burn effect are Tower Defense adaptations; no model of body size or time of day is claimed.

repertoire.name: Super Slash
repertoire.limitation: Escanor delivers a powerful downward axe slash whose damage can be felt several meters away. The base attack represents it as a single-target hit; its measurable reach and group effect are purchased separately.

effects.effect: Escanor delivers a powerful downward axe slash.
effects.reason: The base attack is a normal-damage Rhitta strike, adapted from this described attack.

effects.effect: The slash's considerable damage can be felt several meters away.
effects.reason: The bottom capstone's splash is a Tower Defense adaptation of the described surrounding impact, not a claim about a measured radius in the source.

repertoire.name: Night-time
repertoire.limitation: Escanor is weak at night and is described as weaker than an average human. This Unit does not simulate night or introduce a time-dependent penalty.

effects.effect: Escanor returns to a weak, skittish state at night.
effects.reason: The Definition has no day-night cycle or character-state mechanic, and the plan does not add one.

repertoire.name: The One
repertoire.limitation: The One is Escanor's noon form and lasts one minute. The Unit's Active Ability is a proposed game boost with its own configured duration and cooldown, not a real-time noon transformation or invincibility.

effects.effect: Escanor becomes The One at noon for one minute, greatly increasing his power and strength.
effects.reason: The middle path's Active Ability multiplies the purchased attack's damage and rate for its window as a Tower Defense adaptation of increased power; it does not grant invincibility.

repertoire.name: Divine Sword Escanor
repertoire.limitation: Escanor cuts with a downward hand swipe, which destroys Zeldris' Ominous Nebula. The Definition does not provide a dispel or the ability to destroy that specific force; the plan does not claim those effects.

effects.effect: Escanor makes a downward hand swipe that cuts an opponent.
effects.reason: The plan's attacks are axe strikes and does not purchase this distinct hand attack.

effects.effect: The attack destroys Zeldris' Ominous Nebula.
effects.reason: Destroying or dispelling that specific effect is not a supported Definition mechanic.

repertoire.name: Divine Spear Escanor
repertoire.limitation: Escanor thrusts his index finger with enough force to pierce an opponent. The plan does not change the delivery into a finger thrust.

effects.effect: Escanor thrusts his index finger at an opponent with force enough to pierce them.
effects.reason: The described finger-thrust delivery is not used by a purchase; generic damage or pierce would not preserve that distinct technique.

repertoire.name: The One: Ultimate
repertoire.limitation: Escanor converts his life force to sustain and enhance The One after noon, at the cost of eventually dying. The plan's ordinary Active Ability cannot model life-force expenditure or its fatal consequence.

effects.effect: Escanor sustains and enhances The One by converting his life force into magic power.
effects.reason: Life-force conversion and its cost are not represented by the Definition; the middle boost does not claim them.

effects.effect: Using the technique eventually burns out Escanor's life force and kills him.
effects.reason: The Definition has no unit self-destruction or life-force resource mechanic.

repertoire.name: Large Spear
repertoire.limitation: Escanor briefly possessed a large spear, described as lighter than Rhitta. The selected evidence does not describe a combat technique for it.

effects.effect: Escanor possessed a large spear that was comparatively light.
effects.reason: Possessing the spear does not establish an attack effect to adapt.

repertoire.name: Magic Glasses
repertoire.limitation: Merlin gave Escanor glasses that suppress his daytime form; removing them causes him to transform. The plan does not add suppression or a removal-triggered transformation.

effects.effect: The glasses suppress Escanor's daytime form, and removing them causes him to transform.
effects.reason: The Definition has no suppression or equipment-removal transformation mechanic.

base.name: Rhitta Super Slash
base.behavior: At 0-0-0, Escanor swings Rhitta in a single-target downward slash every proposed 0.95 seconds, dealing proposed 1 normal damage with pierce 1 at range 32. The clear-path attack hits its primary target only, with no splash or secondary hit budget, and the player chooses its targeting mode. This is a Tower Defense adaptation of Escanor's axe and Super Slash, not a claim that the source specifies these numbers.

path1.name: Cruel Sun
path1.buyFor: Choose this path when enemies arriving together are the main concern: it develops Escanor's directed miniature-sun attacks into heat affecting a group and ultimately a volley of impact explosions.
path1.weakness: Its area effect is limited to purchased splash and its clear-path delivery; it has no Camo detection, no independently targeted suns, and no special armor interaction. Repeated copies do not create source-supported independent suns or bypass the attack's ordinary target capacity.

milestones.tier1: 1-x-x increases the damage of Escanor's ordinary single-target Rhitta slash by a proposed whole point per hit; its delivery, target choice, timing and single-hit capacity remain unchanged.
milestones.tier2: 2-x-x extends the ordinary slash's range by a proposed 8 units while retaining the player's targeting choice, clear-path delivery and single-target hit.
milestones.tier3: 3-x-x adapts Escanor's directed, growing Cruel Sun by adding splash to the primary target's hit and increasing ordinary damage; the splash affects enemies around that primary target, shares the attack's per-projectile target cap, and does not replace the axe delivery.
milestones.tier4: 4-x-x increases the ordinary attack's splash and adds burn to enemies damaged by its primary hit or splash, adapting Pride Flare's extreme heat; the status uses a proposed magnitude and duration within the Definition, applies only to enemies actually hit, and does not claim lake vaporization.
milestones.tier5: 5-x-x replaces the single projectile with a distinct volley of two projectiles aimed at the player's selected primary target, each retaining the purchased splash and burn; the projectiles share that primary target and each has its own target-cap budget, adapting Crazy Prominence's multiple exploding suns without independent targeting.

path1.capstoneValue: The fifth purchase changes delivery into a two-projectile volley whose impacts each retain splash and burn, rather than merely enlarging the third and fourth purchases' numbers. Concentrating purchases in it adds a distinct multi-impact behavior to this path; it does not create independent suns or increase reach.

crosspaths.contribution: Proposed early purchases: x-1-x makes Escanor's ordinary Rhitta slash attack faster by reducing its proposed interval; its normal damage, single-target delivery, range and targeting choice remain unchanged. x-2-x further reduces the ordinary slash's proposed interval; it adds no projectiles or new delivery and does not reduce any Active Ability cooldown.

Proposed early purchases: x-x-1 raises the ordinary Rhitta slash's hit capacity to a proposed two eligible enemies in its clear path, including the primary; the attack spends one shared capacity budget, cannot hit an enemy twice in one attack, and applies no status. x-x-2 further raises the ordinary slash's shared hit capacity to a proposed three eligible enemies, including the primary; each enemy can be hit only once per attack, and delivery, timing, damage and player-selected targeting remain unchanged.

path1.referenceExample: The Profile's scale references inform this proposal; the supplied Definition alone authorizes mechanics.

path2.name: The One
path2.buyFor: Choose this path when a manually timed burst against a priority target is wanted. Its permanent purchases strengthen the ordinary attack, and its one Active Ability boosts that same attack.
path2.weakness: The boost is one attack's temporary manual window, not a noon clock or invulnerability. Its cooldown is unaffected by attack speed, and it adds no Camo detection or group targeting. Life-force conversion and fatal consequences of The One: Ultimate are not implemented.

milestones.tier2: x-2-x further reduces the ordinary slash's proposed interval; it adds no projectiles or new delivery and does not reduce any Active Ability cooldown.
milestones.tier3: x-3-x permanently increases ordinary slash damage, adapting Sunshine's rising physical strength while retaining its single-target attack form; this purchase does not yet transform Escanor or unlock an Active Ability.
milestones.tier4: x-4-x unlocks one manual boost of Escanor's purchased ordinary slash, temporarily multiplying its damage and attack rate for the configured Active window; the boost modifies that same attack and returns it to its permanent stats when the window ends, with its configured cooldown starting on activation.

path2.capstoneValue: The fifth purchase adds a bounded follow-up to the existing boost, so the concentrated purchase changes the boost's target coverage rather than only raising its damage. It adapts the concentrated, hurled attack of Final Prominence without claiming a separate attack, a swirling fireball, life-force conversion, or an extra Active Ability.

path3.weakness: The path retains a clear-path axe strike and does not store heat for a separate command-triggered release. Splash and burn only affect eligible enemies actually struck; there is no armor-only damage, obstruction bypass, or unlimited repeat hit.

omittedTechniques.name: Night-time
omittedTechniques.reason: Its central effect is Escanor's time-dependent weak state at night. The Definition has no day-night or character-state system, and this plan does not add a time-triggered penalty; ordinary attack stats cannot express that condition.

omittedTechniques.name: Divine Sword Escanor
omittedTechniques.reason: Its central technique is a downward hand-cut, including destruction of Zeldris' Ominous Nebula. The chosen purchases retain Rhitta's axe delivery, and the Definition has neither this distinct hand delivery nor a dispel/destruction mechanic.

omittedTechniques.name: Divine Spear Escanor
omittedTechniques.reason: Its central effect is a forceful index-finger thrust. No purchase changes the axe attack into this distinct delivery, and ordinary damage or pierce would not represent the technique.

omittedTechniques.name: The One: Ultimate
omittedTechniques.reason: Its central extension sustains and enhances The One by converting Escanor's life force, ultimately killing him. The Definition has no life-force resource or self-destruction mechanic; the ordinary boost cannot express either behavior.

omittedTechniques.name: Large Spear
omittedTechniques.reason: The selected passages establish possession of a comparatively light spear, not a described attack. The Definition adapts combat effects, and no supported combat technique is available to implement.

omittedTechniques.name: Magic Glasses
omittedTechniques.reason: Their central behavior suppresses Escanor's daytime form and triggers transformation when removed. The Definition has no equipment state or removal-triggered transformation mechanic.

scopeLimits: The selected evidence is bounded and does not establish a complete repertoire. This plan lists the named source techniques supported by the supplied sourceTechniques and evidence, not every possible Escanor ability.

Escanor's historical Sunshine ownership is period-dependent: the evidence says he returned it to Mael and later received it back for the Demon King battle. The Unit is a faithful adaptation of that historical subset, not a claim of current availability.

The Definition does not model a day-night clock, dawn-to-noon progression, body growth, personality change, invulnerability, the one-minute source duration, Sunshine's bodily damage, life-force expenditure, or death.
The Definition does not model Rhitta storing heat, releasing it separately on command, flying to Escanor, or changing Escanor's form at night.

All attack statistics, status magnitudes and durations, Active Ability timing, capacities, radii and upgrade effects are proposed Tower Defense interactions, not canon claims, prices, or balance certification.

The Definition requires clear-path delivery and cannot express independent miniature-sun control, environmental vaporization, armor-specific melting, dispelling Ominous Nebula, or distinct hand and finger-thrust attacks.
